summary: AbarVa npm dependency license policy for CI license checks. Denied and unclassified licenses fail the gate unless a package exception is recorded here.

packageExceptions.reason: Transitive package has no license field in package-lock.json; keep as a named exception until legal metadata is verified or the transitive dependency is removed.
